question: Under which scheme has the Rural Development Ministry approved 56 watershed development projects worth ₹700 crore, covering approximately 2.8 lakh hectares across 10 states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PMKSY-WDC 2.0**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **56 new watershed development projects** approved by the Rural Development Ministry under **WDC-PMKSY 2.0** in **10 best-performing states**, with a total cost of **₹700 crore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• States include **Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, Assam, Nagaland, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand**, and **Sikkim**, covering **2.8 lakh hectares**.
 
• Key activities: **ridge area treatment, rainwater harvesting, soil and moisture conservation**, nursery raising, pasture development, and livelihoods for asset-less persons.
 
• Objective: Increase **farmers' income**, address **land degradation**, strengthen **climate resilience**, and promote **sustainable development** through improved natural resource management.
 
• Past success: Under **WDC-PMKSY 1.0**, **significant groundwater table improvement, better surface water availability**, and increased crop productivity were observed.
 
• Previous funding: **₹12,303 crore** allocated in **2021-22** for 1,150 projects spanning **50 lakh hectares** under WDC-PMKSY 2.0.
 
• Focus on efficient fund utilization and visible impact on degraded lands in **hill states and rain-fed areas**.
